name: Numbered asteroids (Lowell astorb)
description: Retrieval nodes for every numbered asteroid in Lowell Observatory's astorb.dat: plan_astorb emits three ranged GETs for the generic HTTP host (the file is about 112 MB; the host refuses a body over 100 MB), parse_astorb joins them and validates the complete gzip (CRC-32, length, fixed columns) and emits one size-prefixed $SBD small-body record per asteroid, brightest H band first, then the largest tenth of them (ranked by the IRAS diameter, else the diameter from H at geometric albedo 0.14; ties by number) and two $EGP groups that list both lanes on the network (osculating heliocentric elements with CCSDS OPM keywords: CENTER_NAME SUN, REF_FRAME ECLIPJ2000, TIME_SYSTEM TDB, km, DE440 GM; H, G, IRAS diameter, orbit class, orbit arc, observations and CEU; PVN provenance). Storage, publication and the schedule belong to the host; the node's auto-publisher announces the SBD.fbs lanes lowell-astorb/astorb-numbered and lowell-astorb/astorb-largest-10pct and the EGP.fbs lane lowell-astorb/astorb-groups.

sequentialJustification.detail: Bounded deterministic request planning and one pass of gzip inflate, fixed-column parsing and FlatBuffer building over one file. No host calls, threads or network access.

Size-prefixed $SBD stream of the largest tenth of the numbered asteroids (ceil(N/10) records, file order): ranked by the IRAS diameter, else 1329 km / sqrt(0.14) x 10^(-H/5), largest first, ties by number. Lane lowell-astorb/astorb-largest-10pct.

Two size-prefixed $EGP groups (QUERY_LIVE) listing the lanes on the network: Asteroids (numbered) and Asteroids (numbered, largest 10%), each with its SDN data query, count, cadence, source and licence. Lane lowell-astorb/astorb-groups.
